windowTitle: Serial integration - I03 Gateway Coordination settlement and managed key

ownerDiffSha256.algorithm: sha256 over (path + sha256(file)) for each owner file, in the listed order

scope: Implement and register the production GatewayCoordination gRPC server inside the existing Gateway Integration unit. It owns a second, distinct database (opl_gateway / gateway schema) in the same deployment unit as the tenant owner, persists original charge/refund/key intent before dispatch, dispatches at most one Sub2API admin balance adjustment per business code, and reads the native positive balance history as confirmation. Managed-key delivery requires an explicit key issuer and an approved Secret store, both of which fail closed when absent.
implemented: services/gateway-integration/gatewaymigrations/0001_opl_gateway.sql: the gateway data owner's own migration, split from the tenant block in docs/spec/target/contracts/schema.sql, guarded on current_database()='opl_gateway'. identity_mappings, tenant_wallet_bindings, key_bindings, wallet_operations, outbox_events, outbox_deliveries, inbox_events, idempotency_records and operations.
services/gateway-integration/identity/gateway_store.go: owner-local store over the gateway schema (wallet binding CAS, wallet operation reserve/settle/read, managed-key binding read/insert/revoke).

services/gateway-integration/identity/gateway_wallet.go: the Sub2API admin wallet adapter - one POST per business code with no retry, exact decimal representability check, affiliate-rebate refusal for 'add', and positive native balance-history confirmation.

services/gateway-integration/identity/coordination.go: BindWallet, Debit, Refund, ReadWalletAction, CreateManagedKey and RevokeManagedKey. Wallet authorization is resolved through the same CloudIdentity authority that shares this process via the canonical BINDTENANTWALLET / CHARGEACCEPTEDOBLIGATION / READWALLETACTION / REFUNDCONFIRMEDDELETION / BINDMANAGEDSECRET actions.

services/gateway-integration/identity/service.go + cmd/server/main.go: the GatewayCoordination group is registered and required only when OPL_GATEWAY_DATABASE_URL opens, migrates and readiness-checks the gateway database.

services/gateway-integration/identity/authorization.go + services/workspace/internal/launch/recovery.go: the create_workspace accepted-operation action set now includes the gateway-audience refundConfirmedDeletion and bindManagedSecret continuations.

verification.environment: real isolated PostgreSQL databases provisioned per owner on a local loopback container; a stub Sub2API admin server; an in-process CloudIdentity authority over real gRPC with verified peer tokens
cases: TestWalletDebitOnceAndReadback: one original charge for an obligation; exact replay returns the same operation id and the stub saw exactly one balance POST; a changed amount is refused; readback works by operation id and by original idempotency key.
TestWalletDebitUnknownNotRepeated: an unconfirmed balance response leaves the operation non-terminal, and a later call reads it back without issuing a second balance POST.
TestWalletRejectsWrongOwner: a wallet operation is not readable under another tenant scope.
TestOwnerDatabaseIsolation (gatewaymigrations): the gateway migration installs only opl_gateway, refuses a differently named database, and leaves its writer scoped to the gateway schema.

notRun: No real Sub2API, Tencent provider, Candidate build, Instance deployment or production readback. The Sub2API wallet is a stub and no real money moved.

refundConfirmedDeletion / refundPlanChangeCompensation / refundSupplementOnDeletion exist on the owner surface but are not yet driven by a real deletion caller; only Debit/ReadWalletAction/BindWallet have a current caller (Workspace funding).

sharedGaps.problem: CreateManagedKey requires a ManagedKeyIssuer and a SecretStore, both of which are unwired here. This is deliberate: a raw key must never fall back into a normal table or a log, so the RPC fails closed until stage 4 wires the approved Secret store and the Sub2API key issuer.
sharedGaps.exactChange: implement the approved Secret store adapter and the Sub2API key issuer, then wire them in main.go for the gateway owner.

claimBoundary: This receipt claims Cloud source changes and focused PostgreSQL-backed, real-gRPC owner tests with a stubbed external wallet and no real money. It does not claim a deployable Tencent chain, a production Gateway or Ledger implementation, an instance deployment, a candidate, a release, or any real charge, refund, purchase or deletion.
secrets: none: the receipt contains no credentials, tokens, keys, customer data or private addresses; the isolated test database and Sub2API stub are loopback-only and created for this run.
